name: AWS CloudFormation Architecture Validator
description: Validates architectural decisions in CloudFormation templates including load balancer configurations, high availability patterns, database strategies, and scaling policies
author: IArchitecture
rules: AWS-ARCH-LB-001: Load balancers must use sticky sessions
AWS-ARCH-HA-001: Resources must deploy across multiple availability zones
AWS-ARCH-DB-001: RDS instances should have read replicas for production
AWS-ARCH-SCALE-001: Auto-scaling must be configured for scalable services
